## Summary

What does this change do and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Tests

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] `make eval` passes if retrieval, policy, or synthesis changed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets or confidential data included

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that needs special attention.
